text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О has successfully
conquered this
year's Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her victory comes as a rare and
extraordinary
achievement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oooh! The Triple Crown! I've won the
Senior
Autumn Triple Crown, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho, the Japan Cup,
and the
Arima Kinen—I have emerged
victorious in all
three of these illustrious
races!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I am nearly suffocated by the
immense love
victory has for me, but
such is the price of being a
star.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, I do believe my accomplishment
deserves a
celebratory parade! Come,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After a lap around the city, we are sent
a gift to
commemorate our completion
of the Senior
Autumn Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, to unveil the memorabilia which I
myself
had created.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Open sesame!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Riiip!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Behold! To mark my successful
completion of the
Senior Autumn Triple
Crown, I give you this
one-of-a-kind
T.M. Opera figure!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It's life-size and elaborately realistic, to
a
frightening degree. The thing might
come alive
any second...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! With masterful craftsmanship
and
breathtaking beauty, it is as if it,
too, harbors my
very soul.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: And it can pose like this!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, the spitting visage of yours truly. By
instinct,
you might just bow your head in
reverence.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: But that's not all!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
It can pose like this as well! I requested

forty-eight articulation points, you see.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Optional accessories include a scepter,
holy
sword, and more. That factory in
Shizuoka
certainly does fine work.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Although it's a fitting piece to adorn the
academy
gates, I plan to take it back to
my room instead.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: You're not going to put it on display?

text_block_list.text:
No. Why would fans need a statue to
worship
when they can see me at the
racecourse whenever
they wish?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This belongs in my personal menagerie.
What
would make my attendant
roommates happier
than for another me
to be present?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: That sounds like a real-life horror movie.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At any rate, Trainer, your work as
kingmaker is
also the reason I could
attain this wonderful
treasure.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But one is not enough! I wish for more
Opera
figures! More, MORE!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Then, one day, my room will become
adorned
with the Twelve Heavenly
Operas.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Should we not aim to conquer the Senior
Autumn
Triple Crown next year as well?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: My room must be replete with me, wall to wall.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I mustn't forget my mini-me. With a press
of this
button here...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Haaaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Opera Os

text_block_list.text:
She even equipped the Opera O figure
with voice
playback. Their doubled
laughter echoes into the
winter sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No matter the memorabilia, her
extraordinary
record remains the same.
Congrats, T.M. Opera
O!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
